Ruth Calloway, the final version is posted in a reply to your message, starting with "FINAL:". I added two lines to Gideon's draft:

- Carrowmere Cloud (Odile Brandt) was checking the Hartford gateway route.
- Mateo's status-page access problem is a separate issue, tracked in INC-4821.

The times are unchanged: first report 10:42, kiosk 1 back 11:03, both lanes working 11:07. All come from the #inc-vtg-hartford log, which you're in. I haven't emailed it to anyone. Mail to Mateo or anyone else outside pemberline.com needs your approval first, so tell me if you want it sent.
